future_generation_gate_requirements.gate_purpose: Ensure all prerequisites are met before any ComfyUI generation submit

max_generations_must_be_declared.description: Maximum number of generation attempts must be declared before any generation
max_generations_must_be_declared.enforcement: Gate must track generation count and block after max reached

workflow_must_be_selected_before_submit.description: Generation workflow must be selected and validated before ComfyUI submit
workflow_must_be_selected_before_submit.validation: Workflow file must exist, be valid JSON, match expected schema
workflow_must_be_selected_before_submit.enforcement: Gate must validate workflow before allowing submit

model_assets_must_be_verified.description: All required model assets must be verified as available
model_assets_must_be_verified.validation: Check model paths, file existence, file integrity
model_assets_must_be_verified.enforcement: Gate must verify model availability before allowing submit

repairability_policy_must_be_loaded.description: Repairability-aware visual policy must be loaded and enforced
repairability_policy_must_be_loaded.validation: Policy file must exist, be valid JSON, be loaded in memory
repairability_policy_must_be_loaded.enforcement: Gate must verify policy loaded before allowing submit

negative_references_must_be_loaded.description: Negative references from previous failures must be loaded
negative_references_must_be_loaded.validation: Reference files must exist, be accessible
negative_references_must_be_loaded.enforcement: Gate must verify negative references loaded before allowing submit

positive_references_must_be_loaded.description: Positive quality references must be loaded
positive_references_must_be_loaded.validation: Reference files must exist, be accessible
positive_references_must_be_loaded.enforcement: Gate must verify positive references loaded before allowing submit

operator_review_required_after_generatio.description: Every generation output must be reviewed by operator before proceeding
operator_review_required_after_generatio.enforcement: Pipeline must stop at operator review gate after generation

visual_qa_cannot_set_production_accepted.description: Visual QA technical pass does not set production_accepted=true
visual_qa_cannot_set_production_accepted.enforcement: production_accepted remains false until explicit operator decision

assembly_downstream_forbidden_until_oper.description: Assembly and downstream stages forbidden until operator acceptance
assembly_downstream_forbidden_until_oper.enforcement: Assembly and downstream gates must block until operator acceptance

gate_status.closed_reason: Fresh visual strategy requires operator review before generation gate can be opened
